Congratulations, Bumblewick! After two heroic tours of obedience school, you’ve earned your degree in Selective Listening. Now you’re off to agility, where the hurdles are high and the rules are merely suggestions. Go get ’em, graduate!

To Fenwick, on your 80th birthday: You left school at fourteen and went straight to work, but you never stopped learning. You taught yourself to read blueprints and used that knowledge to build homes with your own hands. The houses stand as a tribute to your skill, grit, and generous spirit. Here’s to the man who showed us that education can take many paths, and that a life well built leaves a lasting mark. Happy 80th, Granddad!
